verses.text: <pb/><t>Nwam, ọ buru na i nọworo madu-ibe-gi na mbe,</t> <t>Ọ buru na i narawo onye ala ọzọ n'aka ibu onye-mbe,</t>
<t>Ejiwo okwu nile nke ọnu-gi ma gi n'ọnyà,</t> <t>Ejiwo okwu nile nke ọnu-gi nwude gi.</t>
<t>Me nka ub͕u a, nwam, we naputa onwe-gi,</t> <t>N'ihi na i bàwo n'ọbu-aka nke madu-ibe-gi;</t> <t>Je, kwe ka azọtọ gi n'ukwu, riọchie madu-ibe-gi nti.</t>
<t>Enyela anya-gi abua ura,</t> <t>Enye-kwa-la mbubere-anya-gi irù-ura.</t>
<t>Naputa onwe-gi dika mb͕ada n'aka onye-ntá,</t> <t>Na dika nnunu n'aka osi-ọnyà.</t>
<t>Jekuru ndanda, onye-ume-ngwu;</t> <t>Le uzọ-ya nile, we mara ihe:</t>
<t>Nke nēnweghi onye-isi, ma-ọbu onye nēle anya n'ọlu, ma-ọbu onye nāchi achi,</t>
<t>Ma ọ nēdozi nri-ya na mb͕e okpom-ọku,</t> <t>Nēkpokọta kwa ihe-oriri-ya na mb͕e owuwe-ihe-ubi.</t>
<t>Rùe ole mb͕e ka i ganēdina ala, gi onye-ume-ngwu?</t> <t>Òle mb͕e ka i gēsi n'ura-gi bilie?</t>
<t>Nwa ura ntà, nwa irù-ura ntà,</t> <t>Nwa ikpakọba-aka ntà idina ala;</t>
<t>Ob͕eye-gi ewe bia dika onye nējeghari ipunara madu ihe,</t> <t>Ihe-ukọ-gi kwa dika nwoke ji ọta.</t>
<t>Madu nke jọb͕uru onwe-ya, onye nēme ajọ ihe;</t> <t>O ji ọnu nke nēkwu ihe b͕agọrọ ab͕agọ ejeghari;</t>
<t>O nēb͕u iku-anya-ya, o ji ukwu-ya abua ekwu okwu,</t> <t>O ji nkpisi-aka-ya nile nēzí ihe.</t>
<t>Ib͕akuta Chineke azu di n'obi-ya, ọ nēchèputa ihe ọjọ na mb͕e nile:</t> <t>Ọ nēzisa ise-okwu.</t>
<t>N'ihi nka nhuju-anya-ya gābia na mberede;</t> <t>N'otù ntabi-anya ka agētipia ya, ọ dighi kwa ngwọta di.</t>
<t>Ihe isi di nke Jehova kpọrọ asì;</t> <t>E, ihe asa di nke bu ihe-árú nke nkpuru-obi-Ya:</t>
<t>Anya di elu, na ire okwu-ugha,</t> <t>Na aka nāwusi ọbara nēmeghi ihe ọjọ;</t>
<t>Na obi nke nēchèputa èchìchè ajọ ihe,</t> <t>Na ukwu nēme ngwa ib͕aga n'ihe ọjọ;</t>
<t>Na onye-àmà okwu-ugha nke nēkupu okwu-ugha di iche iche dika ume,</t> <t>Na onye nēzisa ise-okwu n'etiti umu-nne. <pb/></t>
<t>Nwam, chebe ihe nna-gi nyere n'iwu,</t> <t>Arapu-kwa-la iwu nne-gi:</t>
<t>Hie ha n'obi-gi mb͕e nile,</t> <t>Ke ha n'olu-gi.</t>
<t>Mb͕e i nējeghari, ọ ganēdu gi;</t> <t>Mb͕e i nēdina ala, ọ ganēche gi;</t> <t>Mb͕e i teta-kwa-ra, nke ahu gēso gi kparia uka.</t>
<t>N'ihi na oriọna ka ihe ahu enyere n'iwu bu; iwu ahu bu kwa ìhè;</t> <t>Ọ bu kwa uzọ ndu ka iba-nba nile nke idọ-aka-na-nti bu:</t>
<t>Idebe gi ka i pua n'aka nwayi ọjọ,</t> <t>N'aka ire-utọ nke ire nwayi nābughi nwunye-gi.</t>
<t>Achọsila ima-nma-ya ike n'obi-gi;</t> <t>Ekwe-kwa-la ka o were gi na mbubere-anya-ya.</t>
<t>N'ihi na ọ bu n'ihi nwayi nākwa iko ka eji eme ka nwoke biarue nání otù ob͕e achicha:</t> <t>Nwunye nwoke ọzọ nāchu kwa ntá ndu di oké ọnu-ahia.</t>
<t>Madu, ọ̀ gāguru ọku tiye n'uwe obi-ya,</t> <t>Ma uwe-ya agaghi-ere ọku?</t>
<t>Ma-ọbu madu, ọ̀ gēje ije n'elu icheku-ọku,</t> <t>Ma ọku agaghi-aru ya n'ukwu-ya abua?</t>
<t>Otú a ka onye nābakuru nwunye madu-ibe-ya di;</t> <t>Agaghi-agu onye ọ bula nke nēmetu nwayi ahu aka n'onye nēmeghi ihe ọjọ.</t>
<t>Madu adighi-eleda onye-ori anya, mb͕e o nēzu ori</t> <t>Imeju nkpuru-obi-ya mb͕e agu nāgu ya:</t>
<t>Ma asi na achọta ya, ọ gākwughachi okpukpu asa;</t> <t>Àkù nile nke ulo-ya ka ọ gēnye.</t>
<t>Onye nākwa nwayi iko, obi amam-ihe kọrọ ya:</t> <t>Onye nēmebi nkpuru-obi nke aka ya ka onye nēme ya bu.</t>
<t>Ọnyá-ntiputa na nlelì ka ọ gāhu;</t> <t>Ita-uta-ya kwa, agaghi-ehichapu ya.</t>
<t>N'ihi na ekworo bu ọnuma nke nwoke;</t> <t>Ọ gaghi-enwe ọmiko n'ubọchi ọ́bọ̀.</t>
<t>Ọ gaghi-ahu ihe-ikpuchi-nmehie ọ bula iru ọma;</t> <t>Ọ gaghi-ekwe kwa, mb͕e i gēme ka ihe-iri-ngo ba uba.</t>
